portfolio.title: Creative work
portfolio.intro: Explore illustration, 3D, writing and audio projects. Each case explains the production, the finished work and related creative services.

desert-sketch.title: Desert sailing illustration
desert-sketch.description: Created a monochrome illustration of a sailing vehicle, dunes and a figure.
desert-sketch.alt: Monochrome illustration of a figure in a sailing vehicle crossing the desert
desert-sketch.deliverable: One monochrome illustration bringing a desert landscape and a figure together in a single scene.

centipede.title: Centipede creature illustration
centipede.description: Designed and illustrated a many-legged creature carrying gun turrets, combining organic and mechanical forms.
centipede.alt: Monochrome illustration of a many-legged creature carrying gun turrets
centipede.deliverable: One character illustration with detailed legs, armour and gun turrets.

moku.title: Moku 3D avatar
moku.description: Created Moku, a fox-boy avatar for VRChat.
moku.alt: Introduction image of Moku, a 3D fox avatar wearing glasses
moku.deliverable: An original 3D avatar with changing expressions, glasses and clothing controls.

bright-friend.title: Bright Friend avatar light
bright-friend.description: Created Bright Friend, an avatar light for VRChat.
bright-friend.alt: Bright Friend 3D work showing a small glowing character and a lantern
bright-friend.deliverable: Handheld, lantern and staff-lantern forms, with light adjustment and a petting response in the handheld version.

letter.title: Letter: short-story writing
letter.description: Wrote Letter, a short story about a scene in a laboratory.
letter.deliverable: A Japanese short-story text published on a fiction platform.

buying-mittens.title: Buying Mittens: recorded reading
buying-mittens.description: Read and recorded Niimi Nankichi’s story Buying Mittens.
buying-mittens.credit: Original story: Niimi Nankichi / Reading: Hatt
buying-mittens.deliverable: A video of the Japanese reading published on YouTube with credit to the original author.

portfolio.faqAnswer: Our cases cover illustration, 3D avatars and interactive features, fiction and recorded readings. Review the production and finished work, then contact Acecore about the related service from each case.
